title: ci(test-ui): add the `Test UI` aggregate job and register it as a required context
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9C2Dy8KN4fv23aea1JR1i9T)_
Fixes #26460

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

**Tier H** (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `AGENTS.md`; `.claude/**` rides along). Draft until an approval from GOVERNED_APPROVERS (os-zhuang, hotlong). The ruleset half — adding `Test UI` to the `main` ruleset's required status checks — is the maintainer's, done in the same sitting as the merge (#9325's two halves; precedent `Lint UI` / `Build & E2E UI` via #25857 and `Type Check UI` via #25878).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在 ci.yml 加一个汇总任务 `Test UI`(job id `test-ui-gate`),覆盖 16 个 `Test UI (k/16)` 分片，任一分片不是 success 就红;分片因 ui 过滤被跳过时为绿。注册表、汇总名册和两处写着必过名单的说明文字同步从 8 个变 9 个。
- 为什么改：裁决 6435318516(字母 A,分阶段)。Test UI 分片都不是必过，队列照样合入 Test UI 红的 PR(#26419 → #26421)。ui 车道的第一阶段读数已完成：最近 50 次跑了 Test UI 的队列构建 flake 0/50(6436579765)。
- 风险与回滚：只新增一个约 10 秒的任务，不改分片、超时、过滤。合入后在 ruleset 里加上 `Test UI` 才生效;回滚就是从 ruleset 删掉这一项再 revert 本 PR。若 Test UI 出现 flake,会把队列条目弹出。
- 先看：`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 新增的 `test-ui-gate` 任务(判定的 case 分支);`scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` 新增的注册行;`AGENTS.md` 第 525–528 行的名单。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs && node scripts/check-aggregator-roster.mjs`,应看到 `ci.yml:test-ui-gate → 'Test UI'` 和 `5 aggregator(s)`;本 PR 的 checks 里应有一个名为 `Test UI` 的绿色检查。
- 需要你做的：批准本 PR,合入时在 Settings → Rulesets → `main` 的必过检查里加上 `Test UI`。

## What changes

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: a new job `test-ui-gate`, `name: Test UI`, `needs: [test-ui, filter]`, `if: always()`, placed right after `test-ui`. It copies `test-gate`'s shape: the `name:` literal and `if: always()` are both load-bearing, and it declares its roster (`OS_AGGREGATOR_MEMBERS: test-ui`, `OS_AGGREGATOR_NON_MEMBERS: filter`). Its one step reads the matrix rollup `needs['test-ui'].result`:
  - `success` → green;
  - `skipped` → green only when `filter` concluded `success` and said the diff reaches no ui path (`ui_tree` or `ui` is `'false'`, the shards' own `if:`), the #4928 guard. That is how a PR or queue build that touches no ui path reads, the same way `Lint UI` and `Build & E2E UI` read `skipped` today;
  - anything else (`failure`, `cancelled`, an unexplained `skipped`, a lifecycle value such as `abandoned`) → red, with an `::error` naming the rollup.
  No other job changes: no shard, timeout or filter edit, and no Test Core line (#25870 edits that section in parallel; the hunks do not overlap).
- `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`: one `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` row (`ci.yml`, `test-ui-gate`, `Test UI`, `authorized` naming ruling 6435318516 and the reading 6436579765). Both `statesTheSet` surfaces' `mustName` gain `Test UI`. Self-test: battery (3) renames the bare `Test UI` name and expects red; battery (9) collides the `Test UI (k/16)` shard name with the bare gate name and expects red, plus the coexistence control.
- `scripts/check-aggregator-roster.mjs`: `REQUIRED_AGGREGATORS` gains `ci.yml/test-ui-gate/Test UI`, the floor that keeps the new aggregate from losing its roster declaration. Self-test batteries (2) and (3) gain the dropped-member and phantom-`needs:` controls for it.
- `AGENTS.md` (merge-queue rule) and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`: the required-set list grows from eight to nine. `check:required-contexts` reds until both name the registry exactly (`statesTheSet`); the count words are hand-followed.

## Why

Ruling A (staged) on #26460, comment 6435318516. The ui step it orders first is done: the flake reading on the newest 50 queue builds that ran Test UI is 0/50, and every Test UI red in the last 24 hours has a named cause that is fixed on `main` (comment 6436579765).

## Acceptance notes

- **Rollup, not per-shard credentials.** `test-gate` counts shard attestations because one rollup word cannot carry several shards' verdicts. The Test UI shards publish no attestation, and adding one is a change to `test-ui` (pinned by the ui lane's `ui/scripts/__tests__`), so this job reads the rollup and fails closed on every value except `success` and a filter-explained `skipped`. The rollup's known blind spot, a matrix where some legs are skipped and the rest succeed, cannot occur here: all 16 legs share one job-level `if:` and a static matrix, and the ui lane pins the width at 16 (`select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts`).
- **`cancelled` is red.** That is also what a shard killed by its own `timeout-minutes` reads, which must not pass. On a superseded push it paints the old sha red, which no required check reads.
- objectui's per-shard reader `ui/scripts/check-test-shard-results.mjs` (the ported `Test` aggregate, row 7 of #25697's roster, "dropped until cutover") hardcodes the `Test (shard N/M)` spelling, so it cannot read `Test UI (k/16)` without a ui-lane change. Not used here; noted for the ui lane.
